scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @smeta/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:full: npm run build --workspace @smeta/shared && concurrently -n api,web,tg -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run telegram:poll"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @smeta/shared && npm run build --workspace @smeta/api && npm run build --workspace @smeta/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @smeta/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @smeta/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @smeta/web
